title: A Morning at Home
content:
It is Saturday morning. Emma is in the kitchen with her brother, Leo.

—Is there any bread? —Emma asks.

—Yes, there is some bread on the table —Leo says.

Emma looks in the fridge.

—Are there any eggs?

—Yes, there are three eggs.

Emma smiles.

—Great! Let's make breakfast.

There are two cups on the table, and there is a bottle of milk near the fridge.

Leo looks around.

—Is there any coffee?

—No, there isn't. We need to buy some.

Emma takes her bag.

—Okay. Let's go to the store!

They leave the house together.

—There are many things to do today! —Leo says.

Emma laughs.

—Yes, but there is always time for breakfast first!
